description: This file defines the 'MethodResultColumn' class, a custom implementation of the 'IColumn' interface for BenchmarkDotNet, used to extract and display the result of benchmark methods during report generation.

classes.name: MethodResultColumn
classes.description: A class that implements a custom benchmarking report column to fetch and display the result of a workload method for benchmark cases.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the column for a given summary and benchmark case.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Static method that instantiates the benchmark case, executes setup and cleanup methods, and invokes the workload method to obtain its result.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether the column uses default value; always returns false.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the column is applicable based on available reports.
